title: Okvorado — Applications & Diagnostic
description: Vue orientée applicatif : quelle application consomme quelle classe de service, et selon quel motif (N sources -> 1 destination). Résolution du nom d'application : table de correspondance port->nom EN DUR dans le SQL (multiIf sur least(SrcPort,DstPort), le port de service quel que soit le sens — mesuré : les ports éphémères >=32768 portent 266,73 GiB contre 179,41 GiB pour les ports de service, donc SrcPort/DstPort nu classerait le RETOUR de connexion, pas le service). Choix (a) retenu plutôt que (b) une colonne applicative peuplée par Akvorado : le catalogue vit en SQLite côté Okvorado (11 398 entrées), inaccessible en jointure depuis ClickHouse ; or 32 ports mesurés font 90% du volume sur 38 588 ports vus — une table d'une trentaine d'entrées couvre donc l'essentiel du trafic, avec repli EXPLICITE 'tcp/827' / 'udp/2055' (jamais vide) pour les 10% restants. Filtre $exporter (multi) : ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote}). Filtre $application (multi) : peuplé par une requête bornée aux applications réellement vues sur la fenêtre (pas de liste figée), même expression multiIf que les panneaux pour rester cohérent.

panels.title: Application × classe DSCP (volume)
panels.description: LE croisement qui manque à ManageEngine côté utilisateur : quelle application consomme quelle classe de service. Barres empilées par application, une couleur par classe DSCP. Répond à « SCCM sature la QoS » : filtrer $application sur l'application SCCM (ex. SMB/microsoft-ds pendant le déploiement GPO) et lire la classe DSCP dominante. Bornée aux 15 applications de plus gros volume x 8 classes DSCP.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_applications AS (
    SELECT
        multiIf(
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 443, 'HTTPS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 80, 'HTTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8080, 'HTTP-ALT',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8443, 'HTTPS-ALT',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 22, 'SSH',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3389, 'RDP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 445, 'SMB (microsoft-ds)',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 139, 'NetBIOS-SSN',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 53, 'DNS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 25, 'SMTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 389, 'LDAP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 1433, 'MSSQL',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3306, 'MySQL',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 5432, 'PostgreSQL',
            concat(if(Proto = 6, 'tcp/', 'udp/'), toString(least(SrcPort,DstPort)))
        ) AS application,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume_total
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND Proto IN (6, 17)
    GROUP BY application
    ORDER BY volume_total DESC
    LIMIT 15
)
SELECT
    f.application AS application,
    f.classe_dscp AS classe_dscp,
    sum(f.volume) AS volume
FROM (
    SELECT
        multiIf(
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 443, 'HTTPS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 80, 'HTTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8080, 'HTTP-ALT',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8443, 'HTTPS-ALT',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 22, 'SSH',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3389, 'RDP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 445, 'SMB (microsoft-ds)',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 139, 'NetBIOS-SSN',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 53, 'DNS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 25, 'SMTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 389, 'LDAP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 1433, 'MSSQL',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3306, 'MySQL',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 5432, 'PostgreSQL',
            concat(if(Proto = 6, 'tcp/', 'udp/'), toString(least(SrcPort,DstPort)))
        ) AS application,
        multiIf(
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 0, 'BE',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 8, 'CS1',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 10, 'AF11',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 18, 'AF21',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 24, 'CS3',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 40, 'CS5',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 46, 'EF',
            bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 48, 'CS6',
            concat('DSCP ', toString(bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2)))
        ) AS classe_dscp,
        Bytes * SamplingRate AS volume
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND Proto IN (6, 17)
) AS f
WHERE f.application IN (SELECT application FROM top_applications)
GROUP BY application, classe_dscp
HAVING classe_dscp IN (${classe_dscp:singlequote})
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 120

panels.title: Application dans le temps (Top 8 + Autre)
panels.description: Série empilée par application — voir un déploiement DÉMARRER (ex. GPO SCCM). Bornée au Top 8 + 'Autre' agrégé, sinon des centaines de séries (une par port éphémère de retour de connexion) noient le graphe — mesuré contre ClickHouse sans cette borne.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_applications AS (
    SELECT
        multiIf(
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 443, 'HTTPS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 80, 'HTTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 445, 'SMB (microsoft-ds)',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 22, 'SSH',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 53, 'DNS',
            concat(if(Proto = 6, 'tcp/', 'udp/'), toString(least(SrcPort,DstPort)))
        ) AS application,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume_total
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND Proto IN (6, 17)
    GROUP BY application
    ORDER BY volume_total DESC
    LIMIT 8
)
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
    if(f.application IN (SELECT application FROM top_applications), f.application, 'Autre') AS application,
    sum(f.Bytes * f.SamplingRate) / $__interval_s AS "débit"
FROM (
    SELECT
        TimeReceived,
        multiIf(
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 443, 'HTTPS',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 80, 'HTTP',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 445, 'SMB (microsoft-ds)',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 22, 'SSH',
            least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 53, 'DNS',
            concat(if(Proto = 6, 'tcp/', 'udp/'), toString(least(SrcPort,DstPort)))
        ) AS application,
        Bytes,
        SamplingRate
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND Proto IN (6, 17)
) AS f
GROUP BY time, application
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Motif de convergence (déploiement de masse) — sources -> destinations
Convergence par application — N sources internes -> destinations
panels.description: Signature du cas d'usage GPO/SCCM : « l'équipe windows envoie l'installer depuis 160 sites vers un datacenter, on s'attend à des flux SMB avec source = PC des sites, destination = serveur SCCM central ». Pour chaque application, compte les SOURCES distinctes et les DESTINATIONS distinctes — une valeur haute de sources_distinctes / faible de destinations_distinctes = motif N->1 (déploiement de masse). Filtre $application pour isoler une application précise (ex. SMB). Réutilise le filtre 'source interne' de app/services/diagnostics.py (RFC1918 + CGNAT 100.64/10) : sans lui, le scan de ports Internet et le maillage P2P dominent le classement (mesure décisive n°1 du module diagnostics). LIMIT 25.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 443, 'HTTPS',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 80, 'HTTP',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8080, 'HTTP-ALT',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 8443, 'HTTPS-ALT',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 22, 'SSH',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3389, 'RDP',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 445, 'SMB (microsoft-ds)',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 139, 'NetBIOS-SSN',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 137, 'NetBIOS-NS',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 53, 'DNS',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 25, 'SMTP',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 389, 'LDAP',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 1433, 'MSSQL',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 3306, 'MySQL',
        least(SrcPort,DstPort) = 5432, 'PostgreSQL',
        concat(if(Proto = 6, 'tcp/', 'udp/'), toString(least(SrcPort,DstPort)))
    ) AS application,
    uniqExact(SrcAddr) AS sources_distinctes,
    uniqExact(DstAddr) AS destinations_distinctes,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume,
    count() AS flux
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
    AND Proto IN (6, 17)
    AND (
        (SrcAddr >= toIPv6('::ffff:10.0.0.0') AND SrcAddr <= toIPv6('::ffff:10.255.255.255'))
        OR (SrcAddr >= toIPv6('::ffff:172.16.0.0') AND SrcAddr <= toIPv6('::ffff:172.31.255.255'))
        OR (SrcAddr >= toIPv6('::ffff:192.168.0.0') AND SrcAddr <= toIPv6('::ffff:192.168.255.255'))
        OR (SrcAddr >= toIPv6('::ffff:100.64.0.0') AND SrcAddr <= toIPv6('::ffff:100.127.255.255'))
    )
GROUP BY application
HAVING sources_distinctes >= 2
ORDER BY sources_distinctes DESC, volume DESC
LIMIT 25
